title: Preview: Manchester City v Fulham, who has the edge?
body:
Manchester City host Fulham in the Premier League on 2026-11-21 [F1]. The Touchline Takes Analyst model gives Manchester City a 69% chance of winning, the draw 20% and Fulham 12% [M1]. In our Football-Data.co.uk results, Manchester City have 2 wins, 0 draws and 3 defeats from their last 5 league games: 6 points, 8 scored and 8 conceded [ST1].

In our Football-Data.co.uk results, Fulham have 2 wins, 2 draws and 1 defeat from their last 5 league games: 8 points, 5 scored and 4 conceded [ST2]. The last meeting in our Football-Data.co.uk results, on 2026-02-11, finished Manchester City 3-0 Fulham [ST3]. The latest from BBC Sport: “Man City thrash Inter to claim first CL win of season” [S1].

This is the kind of fixture where one moment of quality settles everything. Expect nerves early and a lot more freedom once the first goal goes in. The Touchline Take: back Manchester City [M1], but do not be shocked if this gets messy.
